name: Edinburgh Clock Day 2026

venue.name: St Columba's by the Castle
venue.details: Enter via Johnston Terrace, take the stairs on the right down to the main hall.

information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

### This is a specialist side events competition that does not include 3x3. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors.

### PLEASE NOTE: This is a new Edinburgh venue.

Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!
